scope.note: This is a pinned source-audit record, not live execution state, an ownership claim or a gate-completion ledger.

limitations: The documented full-history and 1000-switch gates remain incomplete.
Diagnostic pivots use archive-sourced state and do not establish authenticated bootstrap.
Historical run records describe base commits plus working-tree changes; retain that provenance rather than assigning them to a later artifact.
Short loopback and model tests do not establish real-disk fault recovery or public-network qualification.

remote_ci_observation.query_limit: The commit-workflow connector returns PR-triggered runs; no result at the merge commit does not establish push-run status.
remote_ci_observation.oracle_guard_source_observation: At the reviewed source pin, a missing oracle deploy key produces a passing notice instead of an oracle comparison. That comparison is unqualified.

readiness.rule: A deliverable starts from evidenced prerequisite outputs. Its parent remains open until all final acceptance criteria pass.

next_findings.goal: Fail closed on global-scan errors and propagate real-crate violations.
Fail closed on unavailable oracle qualification and retain truthful proof states.
Keep durable head and visible consensus context coherent across fallible import work.
Acquire exclusive datadir ownership before recovery or mutation.
Reject empty encoded transactions before size calculation can panic.
Use the correct absolute-expiry clock at the runtime discovery boundary.
Reject overflowing log-query ranges before unbounded history work.
Pin query state or return typed unavailability instead of fabricated zeros.
Bind sync confirmation to peer/session/head and expire stale confirmation.

remaining_final_gates: Own-state historical replay and exact positive/negative consensus checks
Real storage-fault, unwind and signer-safety proof
Interoperable live follower and measured resource qualification
Authorized public producer qualification and mainnet follower replay/soak

model_routing.rule: Record the provider used. Do not claim unavailable model execution or an unattended scheduler.

remediation_validation.scope: CI shell orchestration only; separate from reviewed runtime source
remediation_validation.baseline_controls: The original scripts fail the missing-input, executor-scope and real-crate aggregation regression assertions.
